name: model_normalize_detect_vendor
notes: Vendor detection from bare model names (exact first-token lookup, then startswith ladder, vendor/ prefix short-circuit). Harness is a traced copy of model_normalize.c::model_normalize_detect_vendor (the real port drags model_catalog link deps) and traces the same rung ladder; twin imports LIVE hermes_cli/model_normalize.py::detect_vendor and cross-asserts the traced result against the LIVE call each input. Inputs exclude whitespace-padded names: LIVE does model_name.strip(), the C port omits the strip — a documented contract narrowing. Empty name encodes None as "".
